verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no unified view that pulls a user's assigned tasks from several project management tools. The Jira item is a one-way migration ('transition from Jira to Linear') and the import tooling is data import, both adjacent capabilities. 'My Issues → Assigned' covers only Linear's own issues. The GitHub 'sync issues' integration is a single-source code-host sync with no documented cross-tool assigned-task aggregation, so it does not deliver this story.
